generatedProse.practice-connection:
From here, analysis, evaluation and synthesis are what you practise in every module. Each time a brief says analyse or evaluate, each review that draws sources together, each argument you build rather than report, is these skills at work. The habit to keep is simple: take a source apart, weigh it against others, and build your own case from what you find.

That same habit carries into research and professional life. Wherever your work rests on evidence, the ability to take it apart, weigh it, and build a reasoned case is what others come to rely on. The critical skills you have practised here travel well beyond your degree.
